name: MsoTextCharWrap
description: Indicates the type of text wrap.

constants.name: msoStandardCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies wrapping text around the standard boundary of an object.

constants.name: msoStrictCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies text wrapping that adheres to restrictions imposed by some languages such as Chinese and Japanese alphabets.

constants.name: msoCustomCharWrap
constants.description: Specifies a custom text wrap scheme.
